scenes.name: congestion-shift
scenes.prov:
Manual demo scenario — synthetic data. “Delay shifts the weather”: Hand-set: dry and sunny until 6:15 PM, then a rain band with gusts reaches the New York end. An assumed 75 min mid-route delay pushes arrival into the rain and darkness. Weather and the traffic delay are hand-set on purpose; no weather, routing or traffic API is called (only map tiles load). Route geometry and routed times come from a recorded real Valhalla route captured Sat 4:12 PM EDT, Oct 24. Each point uses conditions at its projected arrival time: departure Sun 3:30 PM EDT + routed drive time plus your assumed 1 h 15 min delay mid-route.
What is forecast, computed, estimated or assumed?

captions.text: GlarePilot: weather and sun glare where — and when — you’ll actually drive
Two modes: Real-data planning (live route + forecast) and Manual demo scenarios
Real-data planning: Amherst → Chicago, leaving 8:00 AM tomorrow
Live route + forecast retrieved now — each point evaluated at its projected arrival time
Trip summary (live data): 14h 24m drive, arrive 9:24 PM CDT
Map: route colored by sun glare, with condition icons at forecast trouble spots
Assumed +1 h delay — your assumption, not traffic data — every later point re-timed
“When should I leave?” — same route, departures −3 h…+3 h, transparent exposure score
Lower bars = less glare, wet, wind and after-dark exposure; the best option is marked
Manual demo scenarios — hand-set synthetic data, no weather/route API calls
“Delay shifts the weather” (synthetic): an assumed 75 min delay pushes arrival into rain and dark
“Heavy rain + crosswind” (synthetic): rain and wind icons where the hand-set squall hits the route
“Westbound sunset glare” (synthetic) — now the 3D chase preview
3D chase preview — simulated playback of the planned route, not GPS
Scroll to look ahead along the route — HUD: “Previewing ahead: +14 min · 15 mi”
Play: simulated drive along the planned route (not GPS)
Animation toggle: turn motion off for a calmer, reduced-motion view
Free, keyless data: Open-Meteo forecasts · Valhalla/OSRM routing · SunCalc sun position Manual demos use hand-set synthetic data. Planning aid, not a safety system. Built with Kiro.
